findings: NotifyOnCardDestroyed forwards destroyerCard and TargettedCard to DailyMissionsReceiver.HandleOnCardDestroyed. The three-byte interface declaration is not its implementation. Actual BP_DailyMissions handler saves two frame arguments then invokes graph entry29334, which calls Achievements_OnCardDestroyed, whose wrapper invokes graph entry29114.

Entry29114 checks IsChinaISBN; otherwise clears temporary removals and iterates OnCardDestroyedAchievements. Qualification helper reads match/card ownership/type/cost information. Qualifying rows increment counter, set IsDirty, write the row back, and call CheckIfAchievementCompleted. Completed rows are removed after the iteration.

CheckIfAchievementCompleted calls achievement completion utility, UpdateAchievementCounter, native DailyMissions.SetAchievementCounters and temporary removal append only when AchievementFinished is true and ISBN gate permits. Other captured utilities reach profile/UI/session sinks including ShowAchievementCompleted and SetFeaturedAchievements; these transitive calls remain outside a proof of isolation from game rules.
